decisions.decision: Dockerfile needed @cipherbox/api-client added as dependency for sdk-core DTS build
decisions.rationale: sdk-core depends on api-client but Dockerfile didn't copy it, causing DTS build failure

decisions.decision: Image must be built with --platform linux/amd64
decisions.rationale: Docker host is ARM (macOS), Phala CVMs run x86_64 — ARM image caused exec format error

decisions.decision: Used v35-amd64 tag instead of latest to force CVM image re-pull
decisions.rationale: CVM cached the old ARM latest tag and wouldn't pull the new amd64 version
Old secret not available locally, fresh secret ensures clean start for CVM deployment

decisions.decision: Deploy via Phala CLI locally (not via CI staging tag)
decisions.rationale: First-time CVM deployment needs manual verification of endpoint URL and health before CI automation

decisions.decision: Phala Cloud free tier ($20 credit) used instead of separate testnet
decisions.rationale: Phala has no separate testnet; free tier with $20 credit is the sandbox equivalent
